title: Direct limits of flat local towers
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_R$, $K$ a field, and $\eta:R\to K$ a ring map with kernel $\mathfrak m_R$. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $(A_i,f_{ij})$ a directed system of commutative local $R$-algebras, with $I$ and each $A_i$ in the same universe. Assume every structural map $R\to A_i$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $\mathfrak m_R A_i=\mathfrak m_i$. Suppose compatible ring maps $\psi_i:A_i\to K$ have kernel $\mathfrak m_i$ and composite $\eta$ with $R\to A_i$. Then the explicit direct limit $S=\mathop{\mathrm{colim}}_i A_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is local, its structural map $R\to S$ is local and flat, $\mathfrak m_R S=\mathfrak m_S$, and the induced map $S\to K$ has kernel $\mathfrak m_S$. No surjectivity assumption on the stage maps or the limit map is needed.

proof.text: Form the explicit ring/algebra direct limit S of the directed system and lift the compatible maps ψ_i to q:S→K. The algebra coprojections commute with the structural maps, giving q∘φ=η. Every element of S is a stage representative.

If q(x) is a unit, represent x at stage i. Its image ψ_i(a) is nonzero, hence a is outside ker ψ_i=m_i and is a unit in the local ring A_i. Its image x is a unit. Thus q is a local homomorphism; its domain S is local. A unit φ(r) maps to a nonzero η(r), so r is outside ker η=m_R and is a unit. Hence φ is local. Since q reflects units and K is a field, ker q consists exactly of the nonunits of S, so ker q=m_S.

The ideal m_R S is contained in ker q by q∘φ=η and ker η=m_R. Conversely, a kernel element is represented by a stage element a∈ker ψ_i=m_i=m_R A_i. Pulling back the ideal m_R S along the stage coprojection contains the generators from m_R by algebra-map compatibility; therefore it contains a and its image. This proves m_R S=ker q=m_S.

Replace each algebra transition map by its underlying linear map. ModuleCat.directLimitIsColimit identifies the module direct limit with the categorical module colimit. Apply filteredColimit_flat to the flat stage modules. Module.DirectLimit.linearEquiv identifies this module direct limit with the underlying module of the ring/algebra DirectLimit (the equivalence relation is the same because the transition functions coincide). Transport flatness across these two linear equivalences and use flat_algebraMap_iff.
